note: zero-order absorption over 3.5 h with a lag of 0.75 h

quantities.conc: concentration in the central compartment at the time, 0 before the dose and before the lag
quantities.auc: area under the concentration curve from the dose time (not from the lag) to the time
quantities.scalar: secondary parameters of specs/models.md MOD-SEC-02; mrt is the profile MRT (includes the absorption time, the lag and half the zero-order duration), mrt_system is 1/k

method.closed_form: independent implementation, 256-bit arithmetic (Rmpfr), rounded once to double; the case ka = k uses the analytic limit
cross_checks: matrix exponential (expm) on intervals of constant input
adaptive ODE solver (deSolve lsoda, rtol 1e-12) with AUC and first-moment states
